2607.00472.title: Predicting Lethal Outcome (Cause) And Understanding Key Biomarkers Linked With Acute Myocardial Infarction Using Deep Artificial Neural Network And Ensemble Of Machine Learning Methodologies
2607.00472.paper_summary: Cardiovascular disease is still one of the main causes of death around the world. Acute myocardial infarction (MI), or heart attack, claims millions of lives each year. MI happens when blood flow to the coronary arteries is blocked or reduced, which causes permanent damage to the heart muscle. Without treatment, this can lead to cardiac arrest, where the heart stops pumping blood to the organs, resulting in organ failure and death. Even survivors often face serious problems like heart failure, pulmonary edema, and asystole. Research shows that 5 to 10 percent of survivors die within the first year after an MI, and nearly half need to be hospitalized again. Early thrombolytic treatment leads to better outcomes, so there is a clear need for faster and more accurate ways to diagnose MI. Right now, doctors usually review patient history and use their own experience to find the causes of MI. This process takes a lot of time and can be inconsistent. Detecting MI accurately and quickly can help patients take better care of themselves and prevent fatal events. In this study, we introduce an automated model to predict deadly outcomes of MI and help doctors understand important biomarkers linked to its complications. This approach aims to make diagnosis clearer, faster, and more affordable. The process includes preparing the data, filling in missing values, and handling imbalanced data using SVMSMOTE, ADASYN, and class-weighted methods. We use wrapper and embedded feature selection to find the most important variables, then scale the features for consistency. The model combines Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Light-GBM, and Bagging SVM, and is further improved with an artificial neural network to increase accuracy. We evaluate all models using precision, recall, and other key measures to find the best option for clinical use.
2607.00472.paper_summary_zh: 心血管疾病仍然是全球主要的死亡原因之一。急性心肌梗死（MI），或稱心臟病發作，每年奪走數百萬人的生命。當血流到冠狀動脈被阻塞或減少時，就會發生MI，這會對心肌造成永久性損傷。如果不進行治療，這可能導致心臟驟停，心臟停止向器官泵送血液，最終導致器官衰竭和死亡。即使是倖存者，通常也面臨心臟衰竭、肺水腫和心臟停搏等嚴重問題。研究顯示，5%到10%的倖存者在MI後的第一年內死亡，幾乎一半的人需要再次住院。早期的溶栓治療能帶來更好的結果，因此迫切需要更快且更準確的MI診斷方法。目前，醫生通常會回顧患者的病史，並利用他們自己的經驗來找出MI的原因。這一過程耗時且可能不一致。準確且快速地檢測MI可以幫助患者更好地照顧自己，並防止致命事件。在這項研究中，我們介紹了一個自動化模型，以預測MI的致命結果，並幫助醫生理解與其併發症相關的重要生物標誌物。這種方法旨在使診斷更加清晰、快速且經濟。該過程包括準備數據、填補缺失值，以及使用SVMSMOTE、ADASYN和類別加權方法處理不平衡數據。我們使用包裝和嵌入式特徵選擇來找出最重要的變量，然後對特徵進行縮放以保持一致性。該模型結合了邏輯回歸、隨機森林、Light-GBM和Bagging SVM，並進一步通過人工神經網絡來提高準確性。我們使用精確度、召回率和其他關鍵指標來評估所有模型，以找到最適合臨床使用的選擇。
